sources.summary: Scottish architect Ruairidh Moir has launched a campaign to rebuild the fire-torn Mackintosh Building at the Glasgow School of Art, calling on "an independent body to own and take forward the project". The campaign calls for the building's ownership to be transferred to an independent organisation to deliver a "faithful restoration and reinstatement".
